fields.name: auth_mode
fields.short: The authentication mode to use when accessing this upstream.

fields.name: auth_secret
fields.short: Secret to provide with requests to upstream.

fields.name: auth_username
fields.short: Username to provide with requests to upstream.

fields.name: created_at
fields.short: The datetime the upstream source was created.

fields.name: extra_header_1
fields.short: The key for extra header #1 to send to upstream.

fields.name: extra_header_2
fields.short: The key for extra header #2 to send to upstream.

fields.name: extra_value_1
fields.short: The value for extra header #1 to send to upstream.

fields.name: extra_value_2
fields.short: The value for extra header #2 to send to upstream.

fields.name: is_active
fields.short: Whether or not this upstream is active and ready for requests.

fields.name: mode
fields.short: The mode that this upstream should operate in.

fields.name: name
fields.short: A descriptive name for this upstream source.

fields.name: pending_validation
fields.short: When true, this upstream source is pending validation.

fields.name: priority
fields.short: Upstream sources are selected for resolving requests by sequential order (1..n), followed by creation date.

fields.name: upstream_url
fields.short: The URL for this upstream source.

fields.name: verify_ssl
fields.short: If enabled, SSL certificates are verified when requests are made to this upstream.

fields.name: auth_mode
fields.short: The authentication mode to use when accessing this upstream.

fields.name: auth_secret
fields.short: Secret to provide with requests to upstream.

fields.name: auth_username
fields.short: Username to provide with requests to upstream.

fields.name: component
fields.short: The component to fetch from the upstream

fields.name: created_at
fields.short: The datetime the upstream source was created.

fields.name: distro_versions
fields.short: The distribution version that packages found on this upstream could be associated with.

fields.name: extra_header_1
fields.short: The key for extra header #1 to send to upstream.

fields.name: extra_header_2
fields.short: The key for extra header #2 to send to upstream.

fields.name: extra_value_1
fields.short: The value for extra header #1 to send to upstream.

fields.name: extra_value_2
fields.short: The value for extra header #2 to send to upstream.

fields.name: gpg_key_inline
fields.short: A public GPG key to associate with packages found on this upstream.

fields.name: gpg_key_url
fields.short: When provided, Cloudsmith will fetch, validate, and associate a public GPG key found at the provided URL.

fields.name: gpg_verification
fields.short: The GPG signature verification mode for this upstream.

fields.name: include_sources
fields.short: When true, source packages will be available from this upstream.

fields.name: is_active
fields.short: Whether or not this upstream is active and ready for requests.

fields.name: mode
fields.short: The mode that this upstream should operate in.

fields.name: name
fields.short: A descriptive name for this upstream source.

fields.name: pending_validation
fields.short: When true, this upstream source is pending validation.

fields.name: priority
fields.short: Upstream sources are selected for resolving requests by sequential order (1..n), followed by creation date.

fields.name: upstream_distribution
fields.short: The distribution to fetch from the upstream

fields.name: upstream_url
fields.short: The URL for this upstream source.

fields.name: verification_status
fields.short: The signature verification status for this upstream.

fields.name: verify_ssl
fields.short: If enabled, SSL certificates are verified when requests are made to this upstream.

fields.name: auth_mode
fields.short: The authentication mode to use when accessing this upstream.

fields.name: auth_secret
fields.short: Secret to provide with requests to upstream.

fields.name: auth_username
fields.short: Username to provide with requests to upstream.

fields.name: created_at
fields.short: The datetime the upstream source was created.

fields.name: extra_header_1
fields.short: The key for extra header #1 to send to upstream.

fields.name: extra_header_2
fields.short: The key for extra header #2 to send to upstream.

fields.name: extra_value_1
fields.short: The value for extra header #1 to send to upstream.

fields.name: extra_value_2
fields.short: The value for extra header #2 to send to upstream.

fields.name: is_active
fields.short: Whether or not this upstream is active and ready for requests.

fields.name: mode
fields.short: The mode that this upstream should operate in.

fields.name: name
fields.short: A descriptive name for this upstream source.

fields.name: pending_validation
fields.short: When true, this upstream source is pending validation.

fields.name: priority
fields.short: Upstream sources are selected for resolving requests by sequential order (1..n), followed by creation date.

fields.name: upstream_url
fields.short: The URL for this upstream source.

fields.name: verify_ssl
fields.short: If enabled, SSL certificates are verified when requests are made to this upstream.

fields.name: cdn_url
fields.short: Base URL from which packages and other artifacts are downloaded.

fields.name: content_kind
fields.short: The repository content kind determines whether this repository contains packages, or provides a distribution of packages from other repositories.

fields.name: contextual_auth_realm
fields.short: If checked, missing credentials for this repository where basic authentication is required shall present an enriched value in the 'WWW-Authenticate' header containing the namespace and repository.

fields.name: copy_own
fields.short: If checked, users can copy any of their own packages that they have uploaded, assuming that they still have write privilege for the repository.

fields.name: copy_packages
fields.short: This defines the minimum level of privilege required for a user to copy packages.

fields.name: cosign_signing_enabled
fields.short: When enabled, all pushed (or pulled from upstream) OCI packages and artifacts will be signed using cosign with the repository's ECDSA key.

fields.name: default_privilege
fields.short: This defines the default level of privilege that all of your organization members have for this repository.

fields.name: delete_own
fields.short: If checked, users can delete any of their own packages that they have uploaded, assuming that they still have write privilege for the repository.

fields.name: delete_packages
fields.short: This defines the minimum level of privilege required for a user to delete packages.

fields.name: deleted_at
fields.short: The datetime the repository was manually deleted at.

fields.name: description
fields.short: A description of the repository's purpose/contents.

fields.name: distributes
fields.short: The repositories distributed through this repo.

fields.name: docker_refresh_tokens_enabled
fields.short: If checked, refresh tokens will be issued in addition to access tokens for Docker authentication.

fields.name: enforce_eula
fields.short: If checked, downloads will explicitly require acceptance of an EULA.

fields.name: index_files
fields.short: If checked, files contained in packages will be indexed, which increase the synchronisation time required for packages.

fields.name: manage_entitlements_privilege
fields.short: This defines the minimum level of privilege required for a user to manage entitlement tokens with private repositories.

fields.name: move_own
fields.short: If checked, users can move any of their own packages that they have uploaded, assuming that they still have write privilege for the repository.

fields.name: move_packages
fields.short: This defines the minimum level of privilege required for a user to move packages.

fields.name: name
fields.short: A descriptive name for the repository.

fields.name: namespace
fields.short: Namespace to which this repository belongs.

fields.name: namespace_url
fields.short: API endpoint where data about this namespace can be retrieved.

fields.name: nuget_native_signing_enabled
fields.short: When enabled, all pushed (or pulled from upstream) nuget packages and artifacts will be signed using the repository's X.509 RSA certificate.

fields.name: num_downloads
fields.short: The number of downloads for packages in the repository.

fields.name: num_policy_violated_packages
fields.short: Number of packages with policy violations in a repository.

fields.name: num_quarantined_packages
fields.short: Number of quarantined packages in a repository.

fields.name: open_source_license
fields.short: The SPDX identifier of the open source license.

fields.name: open_source_project_url
fields.short: The URL to the Open-Source project, used for validating that the project meets the requirements for Open-Source.

fields.name: package_count
fields.short: The number of packages in the repository.

fields.name: package_group_count
fields.short: The number of groups in the repository.

fields.name: proxy_npmjs
fields.short: If checked, Npm packages that are not in the repository when requested by clients will automatically be proxied from the public npmjs.org registry.

fields.name: proxy_pypi
fields.short: If checked, Python packages that are not in the repository when requested by clients will automatically be proxied from the public pypi.python.org registry.

fields.name: raw_package_index_enabled
fields.short: If checked, HTML and JSON indexes will be generated that list all available raw packages in the repository.

fields.name: raw_package_index_signatures_enabled
fields.short: If checked, the HTML and JSON indexes will display raw package GPG signatures alongside the index packages.

fields.name: replace_packages
fields.short: This defines the minimum level of privilege required for a user to republish packages.

fields.name: replace_packages_by_default
fields.short: If checked, uploaded packages will overwrite/replace any others with the same attributes (e.g.

fields.name: repository_type
fields.short: The repository type changes how it is accessed and billed.

fields.name: repository_type_str
fields.short: The repository type changes how it is accessed and billed.

fields.name: resync_own
fields.short: If checked, users can resync any of their own packages that they have uploaded, assuming that they still have write privilege for the repository.

fields.name: resync_packages
fields.short: This defines the minimum level of privilege required for a user to resync packages.

fields.name: scan_own
fields.short: If checked, users can scan any of their own packages that they have uploaded, assuming that they still have write privilege for the repository.

fields.name: scan_packages
fields.short: This defines the minimum level of privilege required for a user to scan packages.

fields.name: self_html_url
fields.short: Website URL for this repository.

fields.name: self_url
fields.short: API endpoint where data about this repository can be retrieved.

fields.name: show_setup_all
fields.short: If checked, the Set Me Up help for all formats will always be shown, even if you don't have packages of that type uploaded.

fields.name: size
fields.short: The calculated size of the repository.

fields.name: size_str
fields.short: The calculated size of the repository (human readable).

fields.name: slug
fields.short: The slug identifies the repository in URIs.

fields.name: slug_perm
fields.short: The slug_perm immutably identifies the repository.

fields.name: storage_region
fields.short: The Cloudsmith region in which package files are stored.

fields.name: strict_npm_validation
fields.short: If checked, npm packages will be validated strictly to ensure the package matches specifcation.

fields.name: tag_pre_releases_as_latest
fields.short: If checked, packages pushed with a pre-release component on that version will be marked with the 'latest' tag.

fields.name: use_debian_labels
fields.short: If checked, a 'Label' field will be present in Debian-based repositories.

fields.name: use_default_cargo_upstream
fields.short: If checked, dependencies of uploaded Cargo crates which do not set an explicit value for "registry" will be assumed to be available from crates.io.

fields.name: use_entitlements_privilege
fields.short: This defines the minimum level of privilege required for a user to see/use entitlement tokens with private repositories.

fields.name: use_noarch_packages
fields.short: If checked, noarch packages (if supported) are enabled in installations/configurations.

fields.name: use_source_packages
fields.short: If checked, source packages (if supported) are enabled in installations/configurations.

fields.name: use_vulnerability_scanning
fields.short: If checked, vulnerability scanning will be enabled for all supported packages within this repository.

fields.name: user_entitlements_enabled
fields.short: If checked, users can use and manage their own user-specific entitlement token for the repository (if private).

fields.name: view_statistics
fields.short: This defines the minimum level of privilege required for a user to view repository statistics, to include entitlement-based usage, if applicable.

fields.name: auth_mode
fields.short: The authentication mode to use when accessing this upstream.

fields.name: auth_secret
fields.short: Secret to provide with requests to upstream.

fields.name: auth_username
fields.short: Username to provide with requests to upstream.

fields.name: created_at
fields.short: The datetime the upstream source was created.

fields.name: distro_version
fields.short: The distribution version that packages found on this upstream will be associated with.

fields.name: extra_header_1
fields.short: The key for extra header #1 to send to upstream.

fields.name: extra_header_2
fields.short: The key for extra header #2 to send to upstream.

fields.name: extra_value_1
fields.short: The value for extra header #1 to send to upstream.

fields.name: extra_value_2
fields.short: The value for extra header #2 to send to upstream.

fields.name: gpg_key_inline
fields.short: A public GPG key to associate with packages found on this upstream.

fields.name: gpg_key_url
fields.short: When provided, Cloudsmith will fetch, validate, and associate a public GPG key found at the provided URL.

fields.name: gpg_verification
fields.short: The GPG signature verification mode for this upstream.

fields.name: include_sources
fields.short: When checked, source packages will be available from this upstream.

fields.name: is_active
fields.short: Whether or not this upstream is active and ready for requests.

fields.name: mode
fields.short: The mode that this upstream should operate in.

fields.name: name
fields.short: A descriptive name for this upstream source.

fields.name: pending_validation
fields.short: When true, this upstream source is pending validation.

fields.name: priority
fields.short: Upstream sources are selected for resolving requests by sequential order (1..n), followed by creation date.

fields.name: upstream_url
fields.short: The URL for this upstream source.

fields.name: verification_status
fields.short: The signature verification status for this upstream.

fields.name: verify_ssl
fields.short: If enabled, SSL certificates are verified when requests are made to this upstream.
